# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

## Redefining surgical outcomes

Surgical complications, including infections, bleeding, and wound reopening, impact millions
globally. Without standard definitions and measures to classify surgical site complications,
addressing these challenges is complex. That’s why we’re collaborating with global experts to
advancing standards for safer surgery.

SURGICEL™ Powder Absorbable Hemostat Essential Product Information

INDICATIONS

SURGICEL™ Powder (oxidized regenerated cellulose) is used adjunctively in surgical procedures to
assist in the control of capillary, venous, and small arterial hemorrhage when ligation or other
conventional methods of control are impractical or ineffective. SURGICEL Powder can also be applied
in laparoscopic or other endoscopic procedures when used with the SURGICEL™ Endoscopic Applicator.

The SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator is intended for use in delivering SURGICEL Powder Absorbable
Hemostat to bleeding surgical sites through a 5 mm or larger trocar.

CONTRAINDICATIONS
* Do not inject or place SURGICEL Powder into an open blood vessel. Do not use to treat bleeding
  from large defects in arteries or veins.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used to control hemorrhage from large arteries or veins. The
  SURGICEL Powder and the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator devices was not designed for intraluminal

### References

SURGICEL™ Powder Absorbable Hemostat Essential Product Information

INDICATIONS

SURGICEL™ Powder (oxidized regenerated cellulose) is used adjunctively in surgical procedures to
assist in the control of capillary, venous, and small arterial hemorrhage when ligation or other
conventional methods of control are impractical or ineffective. SURGICEL Powder can also be applied
in laparoscopic or other endoscopic procedures when used with the SURGICEL™ Endoscopic Applicator.

The SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator is intended for use in delivering SURGICEL Powder Absorbable
Hemostat to bleeding surgical sites through a 5 mm or larger trocar.

CONTRAINDICATIONS
* Do not inject or place SURGICEL Powder into an open blood vessel. Do not use to treat bleeding
  from large defects in arteries or veins.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used to control hemorrhage from large arteries or veins. The
  SURGICEL Powder and the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator devices was not designed for intraluminal
  procedures.
* When SURGICEL Powder is used to help achieve hemostasis in, around, or in proximity to foramina in
  bone, areas of bony confine, the spinal cord, or the optic nerve and chiasm, and in proximity to
  tubular structures that could become constricted by swelling, it must always be removed after
  hemostasis is achieved since it will swell and could exert unwanted pressure. Unlike other
  SURGICEL products, SURGICEL Powder cannot be removed from blood clots and complete removal of the
  device application may disrupt the lot and increase the risk of re-bleeding.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used for implantation in bone defects, such as fractures, since
  there is a possibility of interference with callus formation and a theoretical chance of cyst
  formation.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used on non-hemorrhagic serous oozing surfaces, since body fluids
  other than whole blood, such as serum, do not react with SURGICEL Powder to produce satisfactory
  hemostatic effect.
* SURGICEL Powder is an absorbable hemostat and should not be used as an adhesion prevention
  product.


WARNINGS
* SURGICEL Powder is not intended for use on dry (non-bleeding) surfaces or for prevention of
  bleeding.
* SURGICEL Powder and SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator devices are supplied sterile and as the
  material is not compatible with autoclaving or ethylene oxide sterilization, SURGICEL Powder and
  SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator should not be resterilized.
* SURGICEL Powder is not intended as a substitute for careful surgery and the proper use of sutures
  and ligatures.
* Closing with SURGICEL Powder in a contaminated wound without drainage may lead to complications
  and should be avoided.
* The hemostatic effect of SURGICEL Powder is greater when it is applied dry; therefore, it should
  not be moistened with water or saline prior to application.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be impregnated with anti-infective agents or with other materials such
  as buffering or hemostatic substance. Its hemostatic effect is not enhanced by the addition of
  thrombin, the activity of which is destroyed by the low pH of the product.
* Although SURGICEL Powder may be left in situ when necessary, it is recommended to remove excess
  powder with irrigation and aspiration, without disturbing the clot.
* SURGICEL Powder is dry and there may be difficulties in precise delivery under certain
  circumstances. Unintentional device placement may result in powder scattering and device migration
  that may increase the risk of adhesion formation. In preclinical in vivo animal studies it was
  demonstrated that SURGICEL Powder does not increase the incidence of remote adhesions in
  laparoscopic procedures.
* Dislodgement of SURGICEL Powder could possibly occur by intraoperative manipulation, lavage,
  exaggerated respiration, etc. With other SURGICEL products there have been reports that in
  procedures such as lobectomy, laminectomy, and repair of a frontal skull fracture and lacerated
  lobe, when the product was left in the patient after closure it migrated from the site of
  application into foramina in bone around the spinal cord, resulting in paralysis and, in one case,
  the product migrated into the left orbit of the eye, causing blindness. While these reports cannot
  be confirmed to be related to SURGICEL products, special care must be taken by physicians,
  regardless of the type of surgical procedure. Consider removing SURGICEL Powder in these
  applications (procedures) after hemostasis is achieved.
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used prophylactically in a surgical bed to prevent post-operative
  bleeding in a confined space such as in a thyroidectomy or adjacent to implanted devices (such as
  a pacemaker pocket); it has resulted in seroma formation, swelling, infection and compression of
  critical structures (including nerves).
* Although SURGICEL Powder is bactericidal against a wide range of pathogenic microorganisms, it is
  not intended as a substitute for systemically administered therapeutic or prophylactic
  antimicrobial agents to control or to prevent postoperative infections.
* Do not resterilize/reuse. Reuse of this device (or portions of this device) may create a risk of
  product degradation, which may result in device failure and/or cross-contamination, which may lead
  to infection or transmission of blood-borne pathogens to patients and users.
* To prevent clogging with the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator Tip, do not touch the tip to wet
  surface. Be careful to avoid damaging tissue with the rigid tip.
* Do not attempt to trim the applicator tip. Replace the tip if it becomes clogged.
* Do not use the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator if package is opened or damaged.


PRECAUTIONS
* SURGICEL Powder should not be used in conjunction with autologous blood salvage circuits, because
  its fragments may pass through the transfusion filters of blood-scavenging systems.
* Use only as much SURGICEL Powder (oxidized regenerated cellulose) as is necessary and apply only
  where needed for hemostasis. Remove any excess before surgical closure in order to facilitate
  absorption and to minimize the possibility of foreign body reaction such as encapsulation of the
  product, which may mimic artifacts on radiographic images, resulting in diagnostic errors and
  possible reoperation.
* Use minimal amount of SURGICEL Powder required to achieve hemostasis, and remove excess powder in
  the area of drains to prevent clogging. In urological procedures, minimal amounts of SURGICEL
  Powder should be used and care must be exercised to prevent plugging of the urethra, ureter, or a
  catheter by dislodged portions of the product.
* Since absorption of SURGICEL Powder could be prevented in chemically cauterized areas, its use
  should not be preceded by application of silver nitrate or any other escharotic chemicals.
* If SURGICEL Powder is used temporarily to line the cavity of open wounds, it should be removed by
  irrigation with sterile water or saline solution after bleeding has stopped.
* Precautions should be taken in otorhinolaryngologic surgery to ensure that none of the material is
  aspirated by the patient (e.g., controlling hemorrhage after tonsillectomy and controlling
  epistaxis).
* The applicator tip provided on the SURGICEL Powder device is not intended for laparoscopic or
  other endoscopic use. If laparoscopic or other endoscopic use is desired, remove the existing
  applicator tip from the SURGICEL Powder device, and replace with the SURGICEL Endoscopic
  Applicator tip (supplied separately). In laparoscopic or other endoscopic procedures, SURGICEL
  Powder should only be applied using the SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator. Consult the SURGICEL
  Endoscopic Applicator Instructions for Use (IFU) for proper assembly and directions for use with
  the SURGICEL Powder device.

  procedures in which SURGICEL Powder was used.
* The SURGICEL Endoscopic Applicator is supplied with a flexible inner tip inside a rigid cannula.

Hologic helps women around the world live healthier lives.

We develop innovative medical technologies that effectively detect, diagnose and treat health
conditions and raise the standard of care globally.

We know women face unique health challenges at every stage of life, and we are passionate about
being a force for good.

## WHO WE ARE Advancing healthcare through innovative MedTech solutions

Together with leading physicians, universities, and research institutes, we identify and shape
trends to translate them into cutting-edge solutions designed for the most challenging surgical
procedures and conditions worldwide. Interested to find out more who we are?

[ About us ][55]

## HUMAN MEDICINE Products and Solutions
* Medical Specialties
* Interdisciplinary Solutions

[ [Gloved hand selecting a laparoscopic surgical instrument from a sterile tray with various medical
tools.]
General and Visceral Surgery

General and Visceral Surgery

As a pioneer in laparoscopy, we endeavor to develop advanced products that support you in your
general and visceral surgery procedures, including proctology.

][56] [ [Karl Storz flexible endoscope with control handle and curved insertion tube.]
Urology

Urology

Chronic conditions, life-long follow ups, and a rapidly ageing population present everyday
challenges for Urology clinicians. Meet these challenges head on with our minimally invasive
solutions for urological procedures, combining precision telescopes and instruments with specially
coordinated devices.

][57] [ [A doctor holding a digital tablet shows an ear examination image to a woman seated in a
clinic.]
Otorhinolaryngology

Otorhinolaryngology

KARL STORZ has been developing products for use in ORL for over 75 years, and offers one of the
world's leading product portfolios.

][58] [ [Gray C-MAC video laryngoscope blade with curved tip used for airway management in medical
procedures.]
Airway Management

Airway Management

We launched the first commercial video laryngoscope and continuously improve airway management
procedures.

][59] [ [Close-up of a Karl Storz hysteroscopic morcellator surgical instrument for gynecological
procedures.]
Gynecology

Gynecology

See our range of products for gynecological procedures using hysteroscopic and/or laparoscopic
techniques.

][60] [
All Specialties

All Specialties


][61]
[ [Surgeons performing robotic-assisted surgery using advanced medical equipment and viewing
monitors in an operating room.]
Imaging Solutions

Imaging Solutions

A pioneer in endoscopic imaging, KARL STORZ provides innovative, scalable, and modular solutions to
help you build the best chain for your needs and budget.

][62] [ [Surgeons performing an operation in a modern, high-tech operating room with advanced
medical equipment.]
OR Integration

OR Integration

Our customizable systems enable seamless workflows to improve patient outcomes in your operating
room.

][63]

## CUSTOMER SUPPORT Support when you need it

From product guidance to returns and replacement parts, we offer dedicated customer support to keep
you operating smoothly.
* [
  Manuals & Guides
  Our comprehensive media library includes detailed product guidance to provide all the information
  you need to get up and running.
  ][64]
* [
  Online Catalog
  Browse more than 15,000 products, including key features and product details to help you find a
  complete solution for your business.
  ][65]
* [
  Service
  In case of repair, we as the manufacturer also offer our customers top quality, efficient value
  preservation, and flexible repair and services.
  ][66]
* [
  Contact us
  Get responsive customer service whenever you need it to answer any questions or troubleshoot any
  issues.
  ][67]

## Empowering you to succeed

We offer a range of events and training opportunities for you and your teams to network, build
product expertise, and enhance your performance.

[
[Surgeons and medical staff performing a procedure in a high-tech operating room.]

### Training Centers

Find your nearest training centre offering you workstations and training programs across our range
of products.

][68]
[
[Trade show booth for KARL STORZ featuring digital hospital workflow display and branded signage.]

### Events

Discover our upcoming domestic and international trade fairs, conferences and a range of workshops.

trends to translate them into cutting-edge solutions designed for the most challenging surgical
procedures and conditions worldwide. Interested to find out more who we are?

[ About us ][55]

## HUMAN MEDICINE Products and Solutions
* Medical Specialties
* Interdisciplinary Solutions

[ [Gloved hand selecting a laparoscopic surgical instrument from a sterile tray with various medical
tools.]
General and Visceral Surgery

General and Visceral Surgery

As a pioneer in laparoscopy, we endeavor to develop advanced products that support you in your
general and visceral surgery procedures, including proctology.

][56] [ [Karl Storz flexible endoscope with control handle and curved insertion tube.]
Urology

Urology

Chronic conditions, life-long follow ups, and a rapidly ageing population present everyday
challenges for Urology clinicians. Meet these challenges head on with our minimally invasive
solutions for urological procedures, combining precision telescopes and instruments with specially
coordinated devices.

][57] [ [A doctor holding a digital tablet shows an ear examination image to a woman seated in a
clinic.]
Otorhinolaryngology

Otorhinolaryngology

KARL STORZ has been developing products for use in ORL for over 75 years, and offers one of the
world's leading product portfolios.

][58] [ [Gray C-MAC video laryngoscope blade with curved tip used for airway management in medical
procedures.]
Airway Management

Airway Management

We launched the first commercial video laryngoscope and continuously improve airway management
procedures.

][59] [ [Close-up of a Karl Storz hysteroscopic morcellator surgical instrument for gynecological
procedures.]
Gynecology

Gynecology

See our range of products for gynecological procedures using hysteroscopic and/or laparoscopic
techniques.

][60] [
All Specialties

All Specialties


][61]
[ [Surgeons performing robotic-assisted surgery using advanced medical equipment and viewing
monitors in an operating room.]
Imaging Solutions

Imaging Solutions

A pioneer in endoscopic imaging, KARL STORZ provides innovative, scalable, and modular solutions to
help you build the best chain for your needs and budget.

][62] [ [Surgeons performing an operation in a modern, high-tech operating room with advanced
medical equipment.]
OR Integration

OR Integration

Our customizable systems enable seamless workflows to improve patient outcomes in your operating
room.

][63]

## CUSTOMER SUPPORT Support when you need it

From product guidance to returns and replacement parts, we offer dedicated customer support to keep
you operating smoothly.
* [
  Manuals & Guides
  Our comprehensive media library includes detailed product guidance to provide all the information
  you need to get up and running.
  ][64]
* [

  ][65]

  ][66]
* [

  ][67]

## Empowering you to succeed

We offer a range of events and training opportunities for you and your teams to network, build
product expertise, and enhance your performance.

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

Home

Who we are

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]
Previous Next
1. DiversityInc List
2. Medtronic AI Compass
3. Medtronic AI Compass
4. Medtronic AI Compass

Healthcare Professionals

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]
Previous Next
1. Slide 1

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine
[Ultimate victory]

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover
from a career-threatening injury to become the UFC world heavyweight champion.

Explore Tom Aspinall's story

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

[Robust Product Selection]

# 2026 SF Healthcare Week

[ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The CEO

Play Video
Play Video
13:17

### ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The
### CEO behind this year's pancreatic cancer breakthrough walks us through the full results and
### implications | 05/31/26

Dr. Mark Goldsmith of Revolution Medicines describes the benefit seen by advanced patients who
received the pancreatic cancer pill daraxonrasib vs those in a control group of investigator's
choice standard-of-care chemotherapy, and he discusses the medicine's side effect profile. Plus,
next steps for this treatment in pancreatic cancer and beyond.
[ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative head &
neck | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
05:44

### ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
### shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative
### head & neck | 05/31/26

CEO Claire Mazumdar describes the ASCO data, and updates us on the phase 2/3 study, which is already
in the phase 3 portion. Bicara hopes to use the study to eventually gain an accelerated approval.
[ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
35:05

### ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.
[ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO data
release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26]
Play Video
Play Video
14:55

### ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO
### data release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26

Maky Zanganeh and Dave Gancarz share their take on the result, which at the topline showed that
Ivonescimab plus chemo reduced the risk of death by 34% vs the PD-1 Tislelizumab plus chemo, and
they are given the opportunity to respond to some of the pushback heard around McCormick Place.
[ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2- breast
| 06/02/26]
Play Video
Play Video
09:22

### ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
### gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2-
### breast | 06/02/26

These data were for patients with the PIK3CA mutation. The median PFS for the gedatolisib triplet
combo was 11.1 months versus 5.6 months, compared to alpelisib plus fulvestrant.
[ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK in
1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not overshadow this
| 06/1/26]
Play Video
Play Video
15:58

### ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK
### in 1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not
### overshadow this | 06/1/26

He describes the data, which showed a 17.3 months median OS in 55 patients vs. 8.5 months for SoC,
and descrbies why he believes the therapy has an ideal profile for first line patients. A phase
three study is already active and accruing patients.
[ASCO 2026: Known for its leadership in antibody-drug conjugates, Daiichi Sankyo's US CEO and new
Head of Global R&D discuss ASCO data and investments it will be making throughout oncology |
06/01/26]

combined experience. Our team seeks to understand our clients concerns, so that we can provide
solutions.

a better understanding of preventive maintenance practices. Working closely with our clients, our
goal is to keep repair costs down, while maintaining the best repair quality. Our sales staff will
work with you to determine programs best suited to your individual needs.

for any questions.

INTEGRATED HOLDING COMPANY was established in 2005. Because of the great experience of its

remarkable progress in a short time.

INTEGRATED Group of companies provides unique specialized services to various vital industries in
the MENA region, particularly in the fields of oilfields, and energy and infrastructure projects.

INTEGRATED has a wide range of the latest Equipment meeting the needs of our customers. Today, we

## One Endoscopic Spine Partner.
## Every Major Approach.

Clinical demands continue to evolve. Patient anatomy varies. Pathologies differ. Surgical goals
change. The future of ESS is not defined by a single approach. It is defined by the ability to
select the optimal approach based on pathology, anatomy, and surgical objectives.

[**Read more** ][92]
[[Illustration of Transforaminal Monoportal Access with Tessys and Interlaminar Monoportal and
Biportal Acces with Ilessys for spine decompression by Joimax]][93]

## joimax^{®} celebrates:
## 25 Years of Endoscopic Excellence – Innovation. Education. Expertise.


[**Read more** ][94]
[[joimax 25 Years of Experience in Endoscopic Spine Surgery Graphic with 25 year anniversary joimax
logo]][95]

## Shrill^{®} Spinner Blades
## Experience the future of disc space preparation!

Introducing the new joimax® Shrill® Spinner Blades, engineered to deliver more efficient and
effective discectomy for fusion procedures—whether performed through open, MIS, or endoscopic
techniques.

[**Read more** ][96]
[[joimax spinner blades spinning gif animation]][97]
[[joimax Header Picture: collage of joimax products, like NAVENTO Tower, Endoscopes, Shrill Spinner
Blades, EndoLIF and Intracs]][98]
[[ESPINEA Endoscopic Spine Academy Logo on a grey graphical background. Endoscopic Spine Surgery
with ESPINEA® Academy powered by joimax®]][99]

# Your Expert in Endoscopic
# Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery

joimax^{®} is the trusted leader in endoscopic spine surgery solutions, delivering cutting-edge
technology, continuous innovation, and world-class education to advance minimally invasive spine
care worldwide.

## Endoscopic Spine Surgery Products

[[joimax iLESSYS endoscope in action in the OR connected to the camsource Duo Camera head for
endoscopic spine surgery by joimax]][100]

Our endoscopic spine surgery solutions are designed to deliver the least invasive treatment
possible—always prioritizing the well-being and outcomes of our patients

## Quality

##### We take our responsibility for developing, manufacturing and marketing instruments for the
##### benefit of patients seriously. In doing so, we strive to sustain and measurably improve the
##### quality and performance of our products, services, and processes.

[More information][29]

##### Our Quality Management (QM) monitors compliance with relevant national, European and
##### international standards and regulations for the development, manufacture and placing on the
##### market of our instruments. In addition, our QM department continuously monitors standardized
##### workflows and processes in all departments and corporate production sites to ensure, among
##### other things, the highest level of product quality.
##### Based on user feedback and market observations of our sales structures, QM assesses the
##### necessary measures to optimize products and processes.
##### Medi-Globe routinely conducts audits at our suppliers’ facilities to ensure that raw materials
##### and components are always delivered and manufactured to the agreed specifications.
##### Medi-Globe is currently taking the necessary measures to meet the requirements of the upcoming
##### MDR.

## Certificates, product registrations and import licenses

##### In addition to being ISO 13485:2016 certified, all our products bear the CE mark. Furthermore,
##### we operate in full compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and all requirements of
##### international health systems such as, but not limited to, the US Food & Drug Administration
##### (FDA), the Canadian Medical Device Regulations (CMDR), and the Japanese Pharmaceutical Affairs
##### Law (JPAL).

[null]

### Enda Scott

Managing Director
Medical Devices

Enda Scott, born in 1978, holds a degree in Chemistry and a Masters in Business Administration. He
has lead healthcare companies in pharmaceutical, pharmaceutical services and medical device in
Europe and the US for over 20 years. Enda joined the leadership team in 2022 following the
acquisition of MediGlobe by DCC Healthcare.

[null]

### Martin Kropf

General Manager
Sales International

Martin Kropf, born in 1976, holds a degree in commercial Management. He is an experienced
international Sales Expert and worked over 27 years in international environment with various
ownership structures in med-tech.
He is responsible for the Global Sales of the Medi-Globe Group, several direct markets as well as
the Medi-Globes Brazil and leads as General Manager our China office.

[null]

### Michael Hub

Managing Director DAT

Michael Hub, born in 1969, is a State-Certified Technician in Medical Engineering (MTEA Esslingen,
Germany) and Certified Technical Business Economist (IHK, Germany). He is an experienced MedTech
Leader and has been working in the industry for over 30 years. As Managing Director of the
Medi-Globe Group, he is responsible for sales in all business areas in Germany and Austria.

## Our Values

##### Our first responsibility is with physicians, nurses and patients. Everything we do for them is
##### of the highest quality. We also take full responsibility for our employees worldwide and treat
##### everyone with dignity and respect.

##### 
##### Our **SPIRIT of Innovation** best describes what we stand for.

Service For us, service means customer-focused trading and continuously striving to support our
valued clients worldwide. We analyze the needs of our customers and operate proactively, serving
them promptly and accurately. We answer inquiries reliably and bindingly. This allows us to
sustainably increase customer benefits and customer satisfaction. Performance For us, performance
means the joint development of ecological, ethical and social goals for the success of the company
and its customers. We involve the workforce in our planning, strategies and decisions, considering
them our most important resource. Without pressure, we deploy our employees according to their
talents and offer them continuous training. We take advantage of the potential offered by digital
transformation. Overall, we secure our success as well as that of our customers and partners.
Innovation Innovation determines and drives the expansion of our leading market position. We develop
and market highest-quality innovative medical technology solutions, taking market trends into
account at an early stage. We open the innovation process to the outside world by involving partners
and users in idea creation and realization. Through innovation, we secure competitive advantages for
ourselves and for our clients. Responsibility Our responsibility goes far beyond economic success
and environmental sustainability. We strive to keep the balance between the environment, people and
profit through ecologically, socially and economically compatible actions. We treat our employees,
partners and competitors just as consciously as we treat our environmental responsibility. This
enhances our internal and external image and our appeal as an employer. Integrity Through integrity
we create identity and loyalty. We comply with laws, guidelines and rules. Respect and esteem for
all motives and external parties are a matter of course for us, as is the equal treatment of all
people. Employees, customers and suppliers can rely on us as a role model. We create a common
identity and establish trust in our company. Teamwork We see teamwork as fair cooperation and
coexistence of dynamic groups across borders. We encourage entrepreneurial thinking and create an
atmosphere of trust. Our employees are characterized by continuous learning. We are willing to share
our knowledge and experience with one other. By pooling our strengths, we optimize processes and
increase the willingness of our employees to perform for our mutual success.

##### Our first responsibility is with physicians, nurses and patients. Everything we do for them is
##### of the highest quality. We also take full responsibility for our employees worldwide and treat
##### everyone with dignity and respect.

##### 
##### Our **SPIRIT of Innovation** best describes what we stand for.

Service For us, service means customer-focused trading and continuously striving to support our
valued clients worldwide. We analyze the needs of our customers and operate proactively, serving
them promptly and accurately. We answer inquiries reliably and bindingly. This allows us to
sustainably increase customer benefits and customer satisfaction. Performance For us, performance
means the joint development of ecological, ethical and social goals for the success of the company
and its customers. We involve the workforce in our planning, strategies and decisions, considering
them our most important resource. Without pressure, we deploy our employees according to their
talents and offer them continuous training. We take advantage of the potential offered by digital
transformation. Overall, we secure our success as well as that of our customers and partners.
Innovation Innovation determines and drives the expansion of our leading market position. We develop
and market highest-quality innovative medical technology solutions, taking market trends into
account at an early stage. We open the innovation process to the outside world by involving partners
and users in idea creation and realization. Through innovation, we secure competitive advantages for
ourselves and for our clients. Responsibility Our responsibility goes far beyond economic success
and environmental sustainability. We strive to keep the balance between the environment, people and
profit through ecologically, socially and economically compatible actions. We treat our employees,
partners and competitors just as consciously as we treat our environmental responsibility. This
enhances our internal and external image and our appeal as an employer. Integrity Through integrity
we create identity and loyalty. We comply with laws, guidelines and rules. Respect and esteem for
all motives and external parties are a matter of course for us, as is the equal treatment of all
people. Employees, customers and suppliers can rely on us as a role model. We create a common
identity and establish trust in our company. Teamwork We see teamwork as fair cooperation and
coexistence of dynamic groups across borders. We encourage entrepreneurial thinking and create an
atmosphere of trust. Our employees are characterized by continuous learning. We are willing to share
our knowledge and experience with one other. By pooling our strengths, we optimize processes and
increase the willingness of our employees to perform for our mutual success.

Standardized endoscopy software with complete steps, higher detection, and zero reporting time 

[Get a Demo][8]

## Turning Standards Into Action

Everyone agrees that standardization helps **reduce interval cancers and variability**—yet applying
dozens of steps and indicators from memory during real procedures is nearly impossible. 



Medical Pilot transforms **ESGE quality standards** into a **clear, guided workflow that drives the
procedure,** not the paperwork. 



**It is the first platform that brings medical quality standards into the room and effectively
guides the procedure in real time.**

## The workflow engine for modern endoscopy

[A male doctor in a white coat holding an endoscope in a medical examination room.]

#### High-Quality Exams

Visually guided steps and mandatory landmarks make every procedure more complete—without adding
extra time. 

#### Zero Reporting Time

Reports generate instantly at scope withdrawal, saving 6–10 minutes per case and enabling 20–25%
more patients per day.

#### Complete Documentation

Mandatory photo checkpoints and built-in classifications ensure precise, audit-ready records every
time. 

#### Consistent Quality

Standardized workflows reduce variability and ensure predictable quality across clinicians. 

#### Better Detection

On-screen metrics and alerts support safer, more consistent care. Live quality indicators ensure
adherence to clinical guidelines during procedures.

#### Training Mode

New clinicians learn the correct, standardized workflow from day one, rather than individual
habits—improving alignment and speeding up onboarding. 

## Zero typing. Zero guesswork. Zero variation.

See how Medical Pilot works inside a digestive endoscopy room.


The platform connects directly to the endoscope and provides an** intuitive, dropdown-based
interface **where every step follows standardized workflows.
With visual guidance, real-time metrics, and instant photo & video documentation, **complex
standards become effortless**.
Multi-language interface included.
And the moment the scope comes out, the **full medical report is ready.**

## Beyond the Procedure: A Complete Ecosystem

[Two healthcare professionals in blue scrubs discussing patient care in a hospital room.]

#### Patient File—Integrated Document Management

A secure, cloud-based file that stores all medical documents and images.
Patients can upload their records, and the MyMedicalPilot app streamlines communication and
scheduling. 

#### Patient Scheduling & Workflow

Smart scheduling with full patient status tracking, secure cloud access, and automated SMS/email
reminders for seamless coordination.

#### Custom Medical Procedure Editor

A flexible medical workflow editor for consultations, ultrasound, and non-standardized endoscopy
that allows photo capture, secure cloud storage, and customizable templates, 

#### Dynamic Procedure Costing

Automatically calculates the real cost of each procedure—team, collaborators, and resources—for
advanced financial management. 

#### Inventory & Consumables Management

Barcode-based tracking with real-time stock updates and fast scanner integration for precise,
automated inventory control.

#### Analytics & Quality Dashboard

 Real-time insights into performance, quality indicators, case distribution, and trends—supporting
audits, accreditation, and management decisions 

#### Integrations (EHR / HIS)

Seamless connectivity with existing hospital systems, ensuring smooth data flow and minimizing
duplicate work.

## times, allowing us to schedule more patients within the same timeframe.

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is Medical Pilot priced?

We provide **flexible plans tailored to clinics of all sizes**—from individual gastroenterologists
to large teaching hospitals. Pricing is subscription-based and aligned with usage, number of
clinicians, and the value delivered. To receive the exact pricing for your clinic, simply request a
custom quote or book a [DEMO.][9]

How is Medical Pilot installed, and how does it work?

Medical Pilot is a cloud-based platform that requires no complex installation. **It connects
directly to your endoscopy tower through a simple plug-and-play setup and runs on any standard
workstation or tablet.** We help you with this process, no worries. Once activated, it guides the
clinician step-by-step through the procedure, displays real-time quality metrics, captures photos
automatically, and generates the final report the moment the procedure ends. 

How is Medical Pilot’s standardization different from other endoscopy software?

Most endoscopy software focuses on documentation after the procedure. Medical Pilot changes the
paradigm by **guiding the procedure itself**. It transforms complex standards into a live, visual
workflow (drop-down lists) reduces variability between clinicians, and ensures consistent quality
from start to finish. Instead of documenting what happened,** Medical Pilot helps ensure everything
happens the right way — in real time .**

Does Medical Pilot integrate with our existing HIS or EHR?

 **Medical Pilot integrates seamlessly with existing HIS and EHR systems via secure APIs**, ensuring
smooth data flow without disrupting current workflows.
**For clinics and practices that do not have an HIS or EHR, Medical Pilot provides its own
integrated modules**—including patient scheduling, medical file management, and complete
documentation workflows—offering a fully functional digital ecosystem .

How does Medical Pilot handle integrations and data security?

Medical Pilot integrates with your existing HIS or EHR through secure APIs, and for clinics without
these systems, we provide our own modules for scheduling, documentation, and patient management.
The platform is **ISO 27001** and **ISO 9001** certified, fully GDPR compliant, and ensures
encrypted, role-based, medical-grade data protection. 

## About us

[A hand interacts with a medical software interface on a touchscreen monitor.]

Medical Pilot was born during doctoral research in the trenches of digestive endoscopy from the
simple belief that standards should guide clinicians in real time—not live in PDFs. 

We started by transforming endoscopy into a clear, consistent, high-quality workflow, and we built
an ecosystem of modular digital tools to support clinics under pressure. 

Doctors face rising workloads, patients deserve reliable results, and clinics need systems that help
them deliver both effectively. 



Our vision is to bring real-time standardization to more medical specialties, one discipline at a
time—creating a modular, customizable platform that enhances clinical practice wherever consistency
matters most.

Reports generate instantly at scope withdrawal, saving 6–10 minutes per case and enabling 20–25%
more patients per day.

#### Complete Documentation

Mandatory photo checkpoints and built-in classifications ensure precise, audit-ready records every
time. 

#### Consistent Quality

Standardized workflows reduce variability and ensure predictable quality across clinicians. 

#### Better Detection

On-screen metrics and alerts support safer, more consistent care. Live quality indicators ensure
adherence to clinical guidelines during procedures.

#### Training Mode

New clinicians learn the correct, standardized workflow from day one, rather than individual
habits—improving alignment and speeding up onboarding. 

## Zero typing. Zero guesswork. Zero variation.

See how Medical Pilot works inside a digestive endoscopy room.


The platform connects directly to the endoscope and provides an** intuitive, dropdown-based
interface **where every step follows standardized workflows.
With visual guidance, real-time metrics, and instant photo & video documentation, **complex
standards become effortless**.
Multi-language interface included.
And the moment the scope comes out, the **full medical report is ready.**

## Beyond the Procedure: A Complete Ecosystem

[Two healthcare professionals in blue scrubs discussing patient care in a hospital room.]

#### Patient File—Integrated Document Management

A secure, cloud-based file that stores all medical documents and images.
Patients can upload their records, and the MyMedicalPilot app streamlines communication and
scheduling. 

#### Patient Scheduling & Workflow

Smart scheduling with full patient status tracking, secure cloud access, and automated SMS/email
reminders for seamless coordination.

#### Custom Medical Procedure Editor

A flexible medical workflow editor for consultations, ultrasound, and non-standardized endoscopy
that allows photo capture, secure cloud storage, and customizable templates, 

#### Dynamic Procedure Costing

Automatically calculates the real cost of each procedure—team, collaborators, and resources—for
advanced financial management. 

#### Inventory & Consumables Management

Barcode-based tracking with real-time stock updates and fast scanner integration for precise,
automated inventory control.

#### Analytics & Quality Dashboard

 Real-time insights into performance, quality indicators, case distribution, and trends—supporting
audits, accreditation, and management decisions 

#### Integrations (EHR / HIS)

Seamless connectivity with existing hospital systems, ensuring smooth data flow and minimizing
duplicate work. 

## It helps me reduce the time needed for digestive endoscopy. I even started calling patients in
## earlier because I was finishing procedures faster. We’ll definitely be able to shorten endoscopy
## times, allowing us to schedule more patients within the same timeframe.

Gastroenterologist

### Our Partners

[Logo of the Regional Institute of Gastroenterology and Hepatology.]
[Logo of DIGENIO with a modern, abstract icon above the company name.]
[Logo of Centrul Medical Loyal with a medical symbol and text.]

## Frequently Asked Questions

How is Medical Pilot priced?

We provide **flexible plans tailored to clinics of all sizes**—from individual gastroenterologists
to large teaching hospitals. Pricing is subscription-based and aligned with usage, number of
clinicians, and the value delivered. To receive the exact pricing for your clinic, simply request a
custom quote or book a [DEMO.][9]

How is Medical Pilot installed, and how does it work?

Medical Pilot is a cloud-based platform that requires no complex installation. **It connects
directly to your endoscopy tower through a simple plug-and-play setup and runs on any standard
workstation or tablet.** We help you with this process, no worries. Once activated, it guides the
clinician step-by-step through the procedure, displays real-time quality metrics, captures photos
automatically, and generates the final report the moment the procedure ends. 

How is Medical Pilot’s standardization different from other endoscopy software?

Most endoscopy software focuses on documentation after the procedure. Medical Pilot changes the
paradigm by **guiding the procedure itself**. It transforms complex standards into a live, visual
workflow (drop-down lists) reduces variability between clinicians, and ensures consistent quality
from start to finish. Instead of documenting what happened,** Medical Pilot helps ensure everything
happens the right way — in real time .**

Does Medical Pilot integrate with our existing HIS or EHR?

 **Medical Pilot integrates seamlessly with existing HIS and EHR systems via secure APIs**, ensuring
smooth data flow without disrupting current workflows.
**For clinics and practices that do not have an HIS or EHR, Medical Pilot provides its own
integrated modules**—including patient scheduling, medical file management, and complete
documentation workflows—offering a fully functional digital ecosystem .

How does Medical Pilot handle integrations and data security?

Medical Pilot integrates with your existing HIS or EHR through secure APIs, and for clinics without
these systems, we provide our own modules for scheduling, documentation, and patient management.
The platform is **ISO 27001** and **ISO 9001** certified, fully GDPR compliant, and ensures
encrypted, role-based, medical-grade data protection. 

## About us

[A hand interacts with a medical software interface on a touchscreen monitor.]

Medical Pilot was born during doctoral research in the trenches of digestive endoscopy from the
simple belief that standards should guide clinicians in real time—not live in PDFs. 

We started by transforming endoscopy into a clear, consistent, high-quality workflow, and we built
an ecosystem of modular digital tools to support clinics under pressure. 

Doctors face rising workloads, patients deserve reliable results, and clinics need systems that help
them deliver both effectively. 



Our vision is to bring real-time standardization to more medical specialties, one discipline at a
time—creating a modular, customizable platform that enhances clinical practice wherever consistency
matters most.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP

# Welcome

We, **Ovesco Endoscopy**, are a research-based medical device company operating in the fields of
flexible endoscopy and endoluminal surgery.

We develop, manufacture and market instruments and systems for the treatment of gastrointestinal
diseases. We offer comprehensive procedures, not only products, and support you all the way from
training to intervention.

Ovesco’s hallmark are innovative endoscopic clipping systems. The OTSC® is our product platform for
the treatment of gastrointestinal hemorrhage and for endoscopic digestive organ wall closure. Our
clip technology forms a solid basis for many other procedures. Over the years, our portfolio has
been expanded by novel resection techniques such as FTRD® and RESECT+, and also diagnostic sensor
capsules such as the HemoPill®.

Our headquarters is based in Tuebingen, Germany. Furthermore, Ovesco has locations in France, India
and the USA. Patients are treated with Ovesco products in over 70 countries worldwide.

## Discover our latest updates:

#### BARS®

**Lumen reduction for endoscopy**

The BARS® is based on the well-established OTSC® System and was developed especially for lumen
reduction in contexts such as enlarged anastomoses following RYGB procedures. BARS® enables the
simultaneous use of three different application aids with conventional single-channel endoscopes.
This makes it possible to collect tissue evenly and ensures a defined result.

[to BARS®][172]

#### OTSG Xcavator®

**A new dimension in endoscopic grasping**

The removal of difficult to grasp tissue and foreign bodies from the gastrointestinal tract are
often a challenge in endoscopy. The extra-large capacity of the OTSG Xcavator® now allows easy and
effective removal of necrotic tissue, blood clots, food boluses, and foreign bodies.

[to OTSG Xcavator®][173]

#### FTRD® Closing the gap between endoscopy and surgery

**Endoscopic Full Thickness Resection**

FTRD® removes non-lifting and other complex GI lesions that previously required surgery.
Compared to superficial resection techniques, FTRD® can achieve high R0 resection rates,
thereby expanding the spectrum of resection techniques.

[to colonic FTRD® System][174]

#### LiftUp®

**The durable solution**

Due to its thermo-reversible properties at body temperature, the injection agent LiftUp® creates a
submucosal gel cushion.
This creates a distinct and long-lasting safety cushion that reduces the need for re-injections and
exposes the layers well for safe and easy resection.

# NHS website for England Find information and services to help you manage your health

## [Health A to Z][8]

Find out about conditions, symptoms, medicines, tests and treatments, including when to get help

## [NHS services][9]

Find out about NHS services including GPs, pharmacies, prescriptions, hospitals and dentists

## Manage your health
* [ Order a repeat prescription ][10]
* [ View your test results ][11]
* [ Appointments and bookings at your GP surgery ][12]
* [ How to register with a GP surgery ][13]
* [ Find your NHS number ][14]

## NHS services
* [ Find a pharmacy ][15]
* [ Find a dentist ][16]
* [ Find a GP ][17]
* [ Find NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression ][18]

[ Find other NHS services ][19]

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

## Featured
* ### [ Book a COVID-19 vaccination appointment ][22]
  
  If you're eligible for the spring COVID-19 vaccine, you can book a vaccination appointment now
* ### [ Get healthcare cover abroad with a UK GHIC or EHIC ][23]
  
  Get or renew your health insurance card to help you get healthcare in the EU and some other
  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

## More information and advice
* ## [Vaccinations][25]
  
  Information about vaccinations for babies, children and adults, including why they're important
  and how to get them
* ## [COVID-19][26]
  
  Advice about COVID-19, including symptoms, treatments and how to avoid catching and spreading it.
* ## [Baby][27]
  
  A guide to everything you need to know about caring for a baby
* ## [Women's health][28]
  
  Information and support on health, wellbeing, conditions and screening
* ## [Contraception][29]
  
  Information about different types of contraception, including where to get them and how well they
  work

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

„Through intelligent and easy-to-learn access techniques based on our unintech concept, complex
procedures in endoscopic spine surgery are **simplified, surgical workflows are optimized** and both
**patient comfort** and **surgical precision** are sustainably enhanced.“

Dr. Erik Traupe

CMO Unintech GmbH

## The unintech concept

With our unintech concept, we set new standards in surgical techniques. Our approach builds upon the
Open-Surgery Concept: the precision of endoscopy and the experience of open surgery.

unintech techniques are characterized by
* **Tube-in-Tube-Technique**, based on and following open-surgery techniques.
* **Easy identification of anatomical landmarks** for better orientation.
* **Seamless integration** of prior open surgery experience with unintech endoscopic techniques.
* **Transforaminal foraminotomy and interlaminar fenestration** performed under endoscopic
  visualization and guidance.

[ Discover the unintech concept ][56]

### Why should you learn the unintech concept?

Your benefits

Less radiation
exposure

Minimizing intraoperative radiation helps protect both patients and surgical staff, contributing to
a safer working and treatment environment.

Less step
learning curve

The technique is designed to be intuitive, enabling surgeons to gain competence quickly and perform
with confidence in less time.

Less traumatic
for patients

By avoiding major incisions, this approach lowers postoperative pain and supports quicker return to
daily activities.

Less surgery time benefits all involved

Faster procedures lead to greater efficiency, reduced anesthesia duration, and an overall
improvement in patient recovery conditions.

Ready to get the most out of endoscopic spine surgery?

Discover the unintech method and learn how to effectively use our systems and devices in our
training courses. Gain hands-on experience and enhance your skills in endoscopic spine surgery with
expert guidance.

[ Discover our courses ][57]

## Product Overview

### EndoSurg Plus

The EndoSurg Plus System is unintech‘s most commonly used system for full-endoscopic spinal
decompression. It can be used transforaminal as well as interlaminar on thoracic and lumbar spine.
[ More information ][60]

### EndoSurg Standard
* Transforaminal

### EndoSurg Standard

The EndoSurg Standard System is unintech‘s transforaminal system for full-endoscopic spinal
decompression.
[ More information ][61]

### EndoSurg Max
* Interlaminar

### EndoSurg Max

The EndoSurg Max System is unintech‘s mostly commonly used full-endoscopic system for posterior
decompression at cervical and lumbar spine. With the instrument set EndoPLIF the EndoSurg Max system
is used for preparation the disc space for posterior lumbar interbody fusion.
[ More information ][62]

### EndoTLIF

### EndoTLIF

EndoTLIF instrument set is a supplement to the EndoSurg Plus system. It is designed and developed
for endoscopic transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion. The set contains all instruments for disc
space preparation.
[ More information ][63]

### EndoPLIF

### EndoPLIF

EndoPLIF instrument set is a supplement to the EndoSurg Max system. It is designed and developed for
endoscopic posterior lumbar interbody fusion. The set contains all instruments for disc space
preparation.
[ More information ][64]

CMO Unintech GmbH

## The unintech concept

With our unintech concept, we set new standards in surgical techniques. Our approach builds upon the
Open-Surgery Concept: the precision of endoscopy and the experience of open surgery.

unintech techniques are characterized by
* **Tube-in-Tube-Technique**, based on and following open-surgery techniques.
* **Easy identification of anatomical landmarks** for better orientation.
* **Seamless integration** of prior open surgery experience with unintech endoscopic techniques.
* **Transforaminal foraminotomy and interlaminar fenestration** performed under endoscopic
  visualization and guidance.

[ Discover the unintech concept ][56]

### Why should you learn the unintech concept?

Your benefits

Less radiation
exposure

Minimizing intraoperative radiation helps protect both patients and surgical staff, contributing to
a safer working and treatment environment.

Less step
learning curve

The technique is designed to be intuitive, enabling surgeons to gain competence quickly and perform
with confidence in less time.

Less traumatic
for patients

By avoiding major incisions, this approach lowers postoperative pain and supports quicker return to
daily activities.

Less surgery time benefits all involved

Faster procedures lead to greater efficiency, reduced anesthesia duration, and an overall
improvement in patient recovery conditions.

Ready to get the most out of endoscopic spine surgery?

Discover the unintech method and learn how to effectively use our systems and devices in our
training courses. Gain hands-on experience and enhance your skills in endoscopic spine surgery with
expert guidance.

## Product Overview

### EndoSurg Plus

### EndoSurg Plus

The EndoSurg Plus System is unintech‘s most commonly used system for full-endoscopic spinal
decompression. It can be used transforaminal as well as interlaminar on thoracic and lumbar spine.
[ More information ][60]

### EndoSurg Standard
* Transforaminal

### EndoSurg Standard

The EndoSurg Standard System is unintech‘s transforaminal system for full-endoscopic spinal
decompression.
[ More information ][61]

### EndoSurg Max
* Interlaminar

### EndoSurg Max

The EndoSurg Max System is unintech‘s mostly commonly used full-endoscopic system for posterior
decompression at cervical and lumbar spine. With the instrument set EndoPLIF the EndoSurg Max system
is used for preparation the disc space for posterior lumbar interbody fusion.
[ More information ][62]

### EndoTLIF

### EndoTLIF

EndoTLIF instrument set is a supplement to the EndoSurg Plus system. It is designed and developed
for endoscopic transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion. The set contains all instruments for disc
space preparation.
[ More information ][63]

### EndoPLIF

### EndoPLIF

EndoPLIF instrument set is a supplement to the EndoSurg Max system. It is designed and developed for
endoscopic posterior lumbar interbody fusion. The set contains all instruments for disc space
preparation.
[ More information ][64]

# Yazi

⚡️ Blazing fast terminal file manager written in Rust, based on async I/O.

[Get Started 🚀][10]

### Full Asynchronous Support

All I/O operations are asynchronous, CPU tasks are spread across multiple threads, making the most
of available resources.

### Powerful Async Task Scheduling and Management

Provides real-time progress updates, task cancellation, and internal task priority assignment.

### Built-in Support for Multiple Image Protocols

Also integrated with Überzug++, covering almost all terminals.

### Built-in Code Highlighting and Image Encoding

Combined with the pre-caching mechanism, greatly accelerates image and normal file loading.
